text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket had invited me, along with Biwa Hayahide and Narita Taishin, to play a VR game together, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hah!? Carry *more* coal on top of that!?
I thought that last batch finished
the delivery mission!

text_block_list.name: Village Chief
text_block_list.text: “If you're dissatisfied, you are free to give up. 'Fools labor, while the wise prove'—hehehe, feel free to run yourself ragged.”

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the cool words, Village Chief! Woaaah! I'll do my best with the deliveries~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That makes three additional requests now.
That is rather strange, indeed. This is most likely—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"……It means there's another path to beat it, right?
The village chief said earlier that 'the wise shall prove'――"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone! Let's hurry!!
The people waiting for coal must be in trouble!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right! Gotta carry this fast!!
I'll go on ahead~!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Haa... It's useless.
Once she gets like that, she won't listen no matter who tries to stop her."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right.
Let's follow after Ticket for now and see how things go.
We might find a clue on how to handle this.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah... Mayor, I'm back~!
Finished delivering the coal!

text_block_list.name: Village Chief
text_block_list.text:
Foolish creature... Then next time,
you shall deliver 100 parcels.
Remember: fools labor, while the wise prove—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! That's a whole lot of luggage!!
Leave it to me~~! I'll deliver it all in no time flat!

text_block_list.name: Village Chief
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, listen to me until I'm finished talking...!
And so, through sheer willpower, Winning Ticket cleared the village chief's absurd demands one after another—

text_block_list.name: Village Chief
text_block_list.text:
Grrr! You've already finished carrying everything!?
N-next is... Ah, yes! Handing out flyers—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I've already taken care of that!
And since they looked like they were having trouble, I also helped stock the market shelves
and clean the coal mine~~~!

text_block_list.name: Village Chief
text_block_list.text:
!? Mrmph... Honestly...
I've never met anyone quite so deaf to reason...

text_block_list.name: Village Chief
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't you find my request strange?
Nothing but extra demands and unreasonable burdens."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
? Why?
I mean, you're in a lot of trouble, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "This village has so much work piled up!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's why! I was able to do so much work,
and help the mayor and everyone so much—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm sooooo, soooo happy!!

text_block_list.name: Village Chief
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Ticket-zo, was it?
Here is your reward. Please accept it.
And... the entire village eagerly awaits your next visit.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
So this is the game data...
...Just as I thought, the village chief's affection towards Ticket is completely off the charts.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...There certainly was another legitimate route.
Yet Ticket somehow brute-forced it by grinding
her relationship with the village chief to the max.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!! I don't really get it,
but I really, truly cleared it~~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
...That brings back memories of when I first enrolled.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Congrats to all of us on enrolling~~!!
So, let's take a commemorative photo together!!"

text_block_list.name: Same-Grade Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh... No, but...
We're going to be rivals from now on, so...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
We might be rivals, but still—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Let's savor this happiness together!
And when it's race day, we'll all give it our serious all!
Let's be "friends and rivals"!!

text_block_list.name: Same-Grade Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. That sounds nice.
Then let's take a picture together today. As friends.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that, huh...? Out of nowhere, everyone started gathering.
I remember thinking, 'There's a bunch of goody-two-shoes who have nothing to do with someone like me.'

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Because, because! The entrance ceremony is a big deal!
It's obvious that everyone being happy is way better!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Caring for others and acting on their behalf. You haven't changed a bit since back then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, yeah. You always take other people's problems completely to heart, as if they were your own.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's how Ticket brings warmth
to those around her—to all of us.
choice_data_list: Wanna do a commemorative photo shoot?
Shall we take a commemorative photo?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's how Ticket brings warmth
to those around her—to all of us.
choice_data_list: Wanna do a commemorative photo shoot?
Shall we take a commemorative photo?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Is that... really true??

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it is precisely that selflessness.
That is the secret to saving everyone.
I was once again reminded of Winning Ticket's pure, heartfelt consideration for others.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!
Nice idea, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Geh... I'll pass.
It's not like that stuff's for me—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't it fine? Consider it a completion reward
from us for Ticket. Why not let her have her
'once she gets like this, there's no stopping her' moment?
And so, to celebrate clearing the mission, everyone gathered around Winning Ticket for a commemorative photo!
